race.description: Great Southern Inn Super Mdn Plate
race.comment: HELLFIGHTER (4) hasn't been far away in his past couple for the Nathan Doyle barn and now lines up for the Kelley stable back to country level. He rates highly on what he's done recently and wouldn't have to do anything differently here. Looks set for a bold showing. JENNI MOO MOO (11) bypassed running on the Acton at Canberra and Wodonga for this race. She wasn't beaten far in her stable debut 18 days ago over 1080m and steps straight out to 1400m. Drawn well and won't be far away. REINCZECH (12) finished strongly at Goulburn on debut and should be doing her best work late again. MUCHOBOR (6) is next best.
